intro.text: A singer in stormform who leads Lady Leshwi's soldiers.

items.text: Rothan came with Leshwi when she joined Raboniel in taking Urithiru, and was among those sent to make first contact with the humans in the tunnels beneath the tower.
When the Pursuer's soldiers attacked humans to reach the unconscious Radiants in the infirmary, Rothan's discipline kept him and Leshwi's other soldiers from joining in.

appearance.text: Powerfully built in stormform, he seems to crackle with energy, and sparks sometimes flash in his red eyes.

personality.text: Rothan doesn't care much for conversation; he says what he thinks and expects to be understood. He cares about Venli because Leshwi values her.
